nodes.label: Trunk-Based Development
nodes.rationale: Chosen so main is one branch to trust that always shows the latest approved version. Lower overhead than GitFlow for a solo founder (no long-lived develop branch to drift); main-only direct commits rejected because short-lived branches give a cheap review point before work becomes approved. Branches must stay short-lived (hours to days) or they defeat the model.
nodes.norm_label: trunk-based development

nodes.label: Semantic Versioning
nodes.rationale: Tags plus changelog give named, auditable milestones without ceremony. MAJOR = breaking/directional change, MINOR = new capability or phase, PATCH = fixes; pre-1.0 (v0.x.y) signals the project is still forming.
nodes.norm_label: semantic versioning

nodes.label: Keep a Changelog Format
nodes.rationale: Human-readable history of approved versions; every tag gets an entry written when the tag is created, not after.
nodes.norm_label: keep a changelog format

nodes.label: Conventional Commits
nodes.rationale: Structured commit messages (type(scope): summary) keep history legible; types are feat, fix, docs, chore, refactor, test.
nodes.norm_label: conventional commits

nodes.label: Agent Attribution Footer
nodes.rationale: Multiple tools and machines may touch the repo, so every commit carries computer, tool, version, and timestamp read from the real environment to keep history traceable; unknown values are written as 'unknown', never omitted or guessed.
nodes.norm_label: agent attribution footer

nodes.label: Version-Timestamp Convention
nodes.rationale: No silent undated versioned artifacts: every doc, deck, script, config, or report carries a visible Version-Timestamp header; vault notes use the 'updated:' YAML frontmatter field for the same purpose.
nodes.norm_label: version-timestamp convention

nodes.label: Session-End Checklist
nodes.rationale: Mandatory, never skipped: write the session note, update START-HERE, rebuild the graph if docs changed, commit and push. Exists because local-only history does not count as saved and a brand-new session must be able to resume from START-HERE plus the latest session note alone.
nodes.norm_label: session-end checklist

nodes.label: Context Retrieval Order
nodes.rationale: Ordered to minimize token cost: always-loaded protocol file, then START-HERE, then a budgeted graphify query, then targeted vault notes via wikilinks, with raw file reads as last resort. Exists to prevent amnesia-driven re-reading of the whole repo.

nodes.label: DEC-004: Continuous push and cross-IDE agent files
nodes.source_file: vault/02-Decisions/DEC-004 Continuous push and cross-IDE agent files.md
nodes.rationale: Two requirements surfaced once a second collaborator (Claudio's partner) entered the picture: (1) GitHub must always reflect current work, not just work committed at session end, so a partner can pull main at any moment and see the latest; (2) the project must be fully usable from any AI coding tool on any machine, not only inside the Cursor workspace. Keeping push cadence at session-end only, and using separate tool-specific instruction files with duplicated content, were both rejected as alternatives.

nodes.rationale: Amends DEC-001's session-end-only cadence. Continuous push has an overhead cost (more, smaller commits) but directly serves the goal that a human collaborator must never be blocked waiting for a session to 'finish'; more frequent commits in history are intentional, not noise.

nodes.label: Finding: route-generation whitespace is real and unowned
nodes.rationale: Training apps prescribe workouts without location intelligence; routing apps plan static routes without training context; nobody generates the run itself. Enabling stack (OSM routing, free elevation and weather, on-device AI) is nearly zero marginal cost, so the moat is personalization and execution.
nodes.norm_label: finding: route-generation whitespace is real and unowned

nodes.label: Finding: H5 venture-scale verdict UNCERTAIN
nodes.rationale: The wedge alone benchmarks to $5M to $30M ARR by year 5 (Runna anchor): a strong business and strategic exit, but venture scale requires an expansion story (Android, geographies, broader coaching surface).
nodes.norm_label: finding: h5 venture-scale verdict uncertain

nodes.label: Finding: platform giants commoditize generic AI coaching
nodes.rationale: Garmin Connect+ ($6.99/mo) and Apple Workout Buddy (motivational, not prescriptive) raise the bar; differentiation must be what they do not do.
nodes.norm_label: finding: platform giants commoditize generic ai coaching

nodes.label: Risk: Garmin Connect Developer Program paused to new applicants

nodes.label: Guardrail: location privacy is day-one architecture (privacy zones, private-by-default)
nodes.rationale: Generated routes anchored at home reveal home address (Strava heatmap precedent); precise geolocation is sensitive data across GDPR and ~19 of 20 US state laws; EU AI Act Article 50 transparency applies 2026-08-02.
nodes.norm_label: guardrail: location privacy is day-one architecture (privacy zones, private-by-default)

nodes.label: Concept and Positioning (Phase 4) vault note
nodes.rationale: Distilled Phase 4: locked concept, positioning, tagline, verdicts, opportunity spine for the blueprint.
nodes.norm_label: concept and positioning (phase 4) vault note

nodes.label: PRD: route engine 10 constraint inputs, compliance as requirements, safety-claim language rules
nodes.rationale: Full product requirements governed by the locked concept; honest degradation is an engine-wide requirement.
nodes.norm_label: prd: route engine 10 constraint inputs, compliance as requirements, safety-claim language rules

nodes.label: RICE prioritization (30 features scored)
nodes.rationale: Full math shown; confidence tied to Phase 3 evidence strength; 7 sensitivity flags mapped to the interview backlog.
nodes.norm_label: rice prioritization (30 features scored)

nodes.label: MVP scope: 15 features, ~25 person-months, 8 to 10 calendar months
nodes.rationale: Walking skeleton on TestFlight month 3 to 4; launch month 8 to 9; paid layer months 10 to 12. Fits the Strava window.
nodes.norm_label: mvp scope: 15 features, ~25 person-months, 8 to 10 calendar months

nodes.label: User journeys: 5 journeys, 10 design principles
nodes.rationale: Onboarding under 3 minutes, Marcus daily, Priya hotel lobby under 30 seconds, Elena dark morning, Jake plan repair. Principles: explain reasoning, degrade honestly, never promise safe, free path always works.
nodes.norm_label: user journeys: 5 journeys, 10 design principles

nodes.label: Stack recommendation: self-hosted GraphHopper, Supabase PostGIS, SwiftUI MapKit, on-device Apple AI, RevenueCat
nodes.rationale: GraphHopper is the only engine with a native round-trip primitive plus custom cost models over proprietary data. Infra $75 to $95/month at MVP.
nodes.norm_label: stack recommendation: self-hosted graphhopper, supabase postgis, swiftui mapkit, on-device apple ai, revenuecat

nodes.label: Stack choice: self-hosted GraphHopper routing (moat data cannot run hosted)
nodes.rationale: Hosted APIs cannot ingest proprietary crossing/lighting data; a hosted primary reduces Waypoint to commodity routing.
nodes.norm_label: stack choice: self-hosted graphhopper routing (moat data cannot run hosted)

nodes.label: Stack choice: on-device Apple Foundation Models for coaching
nodes.rationale: Health data never leaves the device, collapsing the GDPR Article 9 server surface.
nodes.norm_label: stack choice: on-device apple foundation models for coaching

nodes.label: Phase 5 gate pending: MVP scope, free/paid line, Watch timing, stack approval
nodes.rationale: Recommended: approve scope; launch v1 entirely free with safety routing free permanently; Watch at launch+30; approve stack.
nodes.norm_label: phase 5 gate pending: mvp scope, free/paid line, watch timing, stack approval

nodes.label: Design principle: degrade honestly, never fake confidence, never promise safe
nodes.rationale: Safety-aware is the ceiling of the claim; banned-terms linter in CI; the honest refusal is a trust moment.
nodes.norm_label: design principle: degrade honestly, never fake confidence, never promise safe

nodes.label: Month-1 spike: safety/crossing data buildability at solo-founder scale (assumption A3)
nodes.rationale: The PRD's biggest credibility dependency; decides full data layer vs time-of-day heuristics at launch.
nodes.norm_label: month-1 spike: safety/crossing data buildability at solo-founder scale (assumption a3)

nodes.label: Product Definition Key Findings (Phase 5) vault note
nodes.rationale: Distilled Phase 5 for fast retrieval.
nodes.norm_label: product definition key findings (phase 5) vault note

nodes.label: Phase 5: Product definition and MVP scope (research/05-product/)
nodes.rationale: Five deliverables complete; gate pending.
nodes.norm_label: phase 5: product definition and mvp scope (research/05-product/)

nodes.label: Stack validation: second opinion, no layer revised
nodes.rationale: Layer-by-layer validation with cited alternatives, failure stories, scale narrative to 1M MAU, and a risk register. Requested by Claudio at the Phase 5 gate (DEC-008).
nodes.norm_label: stack validation: second opinion, no layer revised

nodes.label: Condition: Supabase with EU region, on-device health line, auth containment, off-platform backups
nodes.rationale: The on-device health data line keeps compliance at $25/month instead of $950+; auth blast radius contained via own API layer keeps the exit a 2 to 4 week project.
nodes.norm_label: condition: supabase with eu region, on-device health line, auth containment, off-platform backups

nodes.label: Condition: Hetzner with off-provider backups, IaC, restore drill, OVH fallback runbook
nodes.rationale: Hetzner has a documented pattern of abrupt automated account suspensions and no published SLA; the conditions reduce impact from critical to low.
nodes.norm_label: condition: hetzner with off-provider backups, iac, restore drill, ovh fallback runbook

nodes.label: Risk: GraphHopper US-wide foot-graph memory sizing unproven (week-one load test mandatory)
nodes.rationale: Public sizing evidence is car-profile-biased; import peak is often conflated with serving footprint.
nodes.norm_label: risk: graphhopper us-wide foot-graph memory sizing unproven (week-one load test mandatory)

nodes.label: Verdict: Vercel serves research artifacts only, never the app backend
nodes.rationale: Vercel Functions cap at 4 GB and 30 minutes with no persistent processes; GraphHopper's persistent multi-GB JVM structurally cannot run there.
nodes.norm_label: verdict: vercel serves research artifacts only, never the app backend

nodes.source_file: vault/02-Decisions/DEC-008 Phase 5 gate MVP approved stack in validation.md

nodes.label: Decision: safety-aware routing free permanently (with v1 launching entirely free)

nodes.norm_label: decision: safety-aware routing free permanently (with v1 launching entirely free)

nodes.rationale: Dashboard and graph explorer already live; formal gate still open.
nodes.norm_label: phase 7: html research dashboard (partially done, pulled forward)

nodes.label: Phase 8: Business Blueprint (not started)
nodes.rationale: Blocked on Phases 5 to 7.
nodes.norm_label: phase 8: business blueprint (not started)

nodes.label: Database deep dive round 2: split architecture verdict
nodes.rationale: 12 candidates scored on security/reliability/compliance/stability; Aiven 4.46 vs Supabase 3.45. Supersedes round 1's Supabase-with-conditions verdict.
nodes.norm_label: database deep dive round 2: split architecture verdict

nodes.label: Verdict: Aiven for PostgreSQL (EU) for personal data, replacing Supabase
nodes.rationale: EU-incorporated specialist, ISO 27001 + SOC 2 Type II, 99.99% SLA, PITR standard, firewalled to the app server.
nodes.norm_label: verdict: aiven for postgresql (eu) for personal data, replacing supabase

nodes.label: Verdict: self-managed PostGIS on Hetzner private network for the geospatial moat
nodes.rationale: Zero public exposure, zero personal data, rebuildable in hours, off-provider backups.
nodes.norm_label: verdict: self-managed postgis on hetzner private network for the geospatial moat

nodes.label: Verdict: auth decoupled into the API layer via Better Auth
nodes.rationale: Identity tables live in Aiven; deletes the auth lock-in exit problem. Ory Kratos is the security-maximal alternative.
nodes.norm_label: verdict: auth decoupled into the api layer via better auth

nodes.label: Dual-platform strategy: staged cross-platform on React Native recommended (Option D)
nodes.rationale: ~29-31 person-months, iOS month 9-10, Android +4-8 weeks, one codebase. Simultaneous dual-native (38-40 pm) endangers the competitive window. Runna is the existence proof.
nodes.norm_label: dual-platform strategy: staged cross-platform on react native recommended (option d)

nodes.label: Client stack amendment if dual-platform: React Native + MapLibre on both platforms
nodes.rationale: Replaces SwiftUI + MapKit; amends DEC-006-adjacent stack choices; MapLibre aligns with Ferrostar.
nodes.norm_label: client stack amendment if dual-platform: react native + maplibre on both platforms

nodes.label: API integration map: ~20 required integrations, ~$80-130/mo external services at MVP
nodes.rationale: 7 domains, 30 cataloged including fallbacks; 6 gate the walking skeleton; ~$350-500/mo at 10k MAU; store commissions 15% small-business tiers.
nodes.norm_label: api integration map: ~20 required integrations, ~$80-130/mo external services at mvp

nodes.label: Risk: Strava discretionary API program admission and 2026 AI ban
nodes.rationale: June 2026 API agreement with a sweeping AI ban and 2,000-upload/day default ceiling; Waypoint stays write-only.
nodes.norm_label: risk: strava discretionary api program admission and 2026 ai ban

nodes.label: Risk: Android Health Connect and fine-location review lead times
nodes.rationale: Play Console paperwork must start month 1 if Android is greenlit; Health Connect approval ~2 weeks calendar lead.
nodes.norm_label: risk: android health connect and fine-location review lead times

nodes.label: Open gate: revised stack (dashboard card 8) and platform strategy (card 9) await founder decision
nodes.rationale: Both decisions get new DECs; Option C/D also updates mvp-scope effort and the Charter client stack. Blocks Phase 6.
nodes.norm_label: open gate: revised stack (dashboard card 8) and platform strategy (card 9) await founder decision

nodes.label: DEC-009: data layer revised to Aiven split architecture with decoupled auth
nodes.source_file: vault/02-Decisions/DEC-009 Revised data layer Aiven split architecture with decoupled auth.md
nodes.rationale: Supabase dropped. Aiven for PostgreSQL (EU) for personal data, self-managed PostGIS on Hetzner for the moat, Better Auth in Waypoint's API layer. Approved 2026-08-06 with an explicit revisit clause.
nodes.norm_label: dec-009: data layer revised to aiven split architecture with decoupled auth

nodes.label: DEC-010: staged cross-platform MVP on React Native, iOS first then Android
nodes.source_file: vault/02-Decisions/DEC-010 Staged cross-platform MVP on React Native.md
nodes.rationale: One React Native codebase with MapLibre on both platforms; iOS month 9-10, Android month 10-12; effort amended to ~29-31 person-months. Approved 2026-08-06.
nodes.norm_label: dec-010: staged cross-platform mvp on react native, ios first then android

nodes.label: Stack revisit clause: DEC-009 is deliberately re-openable at four checkpoints
nodes.source_file: vault/02-Decisions/DEC-009 Revised data layer Aiven split architecture with decoupled auth.md
nodes.rationale: Founder instruction that infrastructure detail must not block product definition. Re-open before the walking skeleton, when architecture design starts, at Aiven contract time, or if ops burden proves real.
nodes.norm_label: stack revisit clause: dec-009 is deliberately re-openable at four checkpoints

nodes.label: Phase 5 gate CLOSED: all five decisions made, Phase 6 unblocked
nodes.source_file: vault/02-Decisions/DEC-010 Staged cross-platform MVP on React Native.md
nodes.rationale: DEC-008 (scope, free launch, Watch), DEC-009 (data layer), DEC-010 (platform). Closed 2026-08-06.
nodes.norm_label: phase 5 gate closed: all five decisions made, phase 6 unblocked

nodes.label: Business Model Canvas: nine blocks plus cross-document reconciliation
nodes.rationale: The integrating Phase 6 document. Holds the reconciliation of the four parallel studies and the six gate cards.
nodes.norm_label: business model canvas: nine blocks plus cross-document reconciliation

nodes.label: Revenue model: $99.99/yr list with a price-preserved Founding Runner tier
nodes.rationale: $99.99/yr, $12.99/mo, 21-day annual-only trial, Founding Runner $69.99/yr. Lifetime tier and data monetization rejected.
nodes.norm_label: revenue model: $99.99/yr list with a price-preserved founding runner tier

nodes.label: Unit economics: break-even ~3,000 subscribers, paid acquisition unviable
nodes.rationale: Directional model across a $4.99-$11.99 band. 63 percent gross margin at the mid price at 10k MAU; free active user costs under $1/year.
nodes.norm_label: unit economics: break-even ~3,000 subscribers, paid acquisition unviable

nodes.label: Metrics: Weekly Routed Runners as North Star, Good Route Rate for quality
nodes.rationale: 80 percent completion floor inside the North Star definition; activation is a completed recorded run; ten guardrails including honest-refusal stability.
nodes.norm_label: metrics: weekly routed runners as north star, good route rate for quality

nodes.label: GTM: one metro, one segment, run clubs first, Android date is the real launch
nodes.rationale: Beachhead is the urban committed amateur running from a home doorstep. SEO and paid acquisition argued against explicitly.
nodes.norm_label: gtm: one metro, one segment, run clubs first, android date is the real launch

nodes.label: Governing finding: unit economics are a function of distribution, not pricing
nodes.rationale: Paid acquisition returns 53 to 70 cents on the dollar at every credible price; the model needs roughly 84 percent organic acquisition to clear 3:1. If community-first distribution fails, no price rescues the model.
nodes.norm_label: governing finding: unit economics are a function of distribution, not pricing

nodes.label: Recommended price: $99.99/yr list, list high and discount never the reverse
nodes.rationale: Apple applies price decreases silently but requires explicit consent for increases above roughly 50 percent or $50/year.
nodes.norm_label: recommended price: $99.99/yr list, list high and discount never the reverse

nodes.label: North Star: Weekly Routed Runners with an 80 percent completion floor
nodes.rationale: Cannot be inflated by shipping routes people abandon. Rejects total routes generated, which rises when routes are bad.
nodes.norm_label: north star: weekly routed runners with an 80 percent completion floor

nodes.label: Beachhead: one metro, one segment, urban committed amateur from a home doorstep
nodes.rationale: Route quality depends on OpenStreetMap pedestrian data density, so a thin national launch ships bad routes to most of the country.
nodes.norm_label: beachhead: one metro, one segment, urban committed amateur from a home doorstep

nodes.label: Conflict: TelemetryDeck cannot deliver cohort retention because it provides no stable identifier
nodes.rationale: The privacy-preserving analytics choice in the API integration map cannot produce the metric the PRD's own goals require. Recommended fix: first-party Postgres event table on the existing account identifier.
nodes.norm_label: conflict: telemetrydeck cannot deliver cohort retention because it provides no stable identifier

nodes.label: Riskiest assumption A1: whether the beachhead metro clears the OSM pedestrian-data floor
nodes.rationale: Sits underneath the segment choice, metro choice, top channel, and the differentiation claim. The month-1 spike should be treated as a go-to-market gate, not only a technical one.
nodes.norm_label: riskiest assumption a1: whether the beachhead metro clears the osm pedestrian-data floor

nodes.label: Phase 6 gate OPEN: six founder decisions staged on the dashboard
nodes.rationale: Price, free/paid boundary breadth, the analytics identity fix, re-basing PRD G3/G4, the beachhead metro, and which date is the real public launch.
nodes.norm_label: phase 6 gate open: six founder decisions staged on the dashboard
